<!-- Camp description -->
  <section data-nk="expect" class="section">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="split">
        <div class="split__media">
          <img src="/assets/images/img-20230519-wa0055.jpg?v=1786900858" alt="8 days Kitesurf Camp Essaouira" loading="lazy" width="620" height="465">
        </div>
        <div>
          <h2 class="split__title">8 Days / 7 Nights 12 Hours Kitesurf Lessons</h2>
          <p>Discover the ultimate kitesurfing adventure in Essaouira, Morocco, with Naneakite! This fantastic package covers everything you need for an unforgettable experience – comfortable accommodation, comprehensive lessons, and top-of-the-line equipment. Feel completely at ease as you embark on your kitesurfing journey at the stunning Essaouira kitespot.</p><p>Here, safety is paramount, allowing you to focus solely on honing your skills. Our kitesurfing courses are conducted in small groups, ensuring personalized attention with a maximum of three people per instructor.</p><p>You can trust our certified instructors to guide you every step of the way, ensuring both your progress and enjoyment throughout the course. The lessons commence on land, where you’ll gain a solid foundation and understanding of the techniques. As you grow more confident, you’ll seamlessly transition into the water, where the real excitement begins. Our friendly team is dedicated to seeing you succeed and will make sure you feel comfortable with both the information and the equipment. Rest assured, Naneakite boasts a team of highly successful instructors, with a proven track record of helping students master kitesurfing in no time. So, get ready to hit the waves and experience the thrill of kitesurfing under the expert guidance of Naneakite – an adventure you won’t want to miss!</p>        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

<!-- What to expect (skipped when it only repeats the description above) -->
  <section data-nk="facilities" class="section">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="split split--rev">
        <div class="split__media">
          <img src="/assets/images/img-20230519-wa0058.jpg?v=1786900854" alt="what to expect" loading="lazy" width="620" height="465">
        </div>
        <div>
          <h2 class="split__title">what to expect</h2>
          <p>Look no further – this kitesurf camp is the perfect choice for kitesurfers of all levels, whether you’re a complete beginner or an intermediate rider. Our program is tailored to meet your individual needs, ensuring you get the most out of your kitesurfing journey.</p><p>Regardless of your current skill level, our experienced instructors will assess where you stand and start your lessons accordingly. From there, we’ll guide you through each step, equipping you with the necessary skills and knowledge to become a confident and independent kitesurfer.</p><p>To ensure personalized attention, our classes maintain a maximum of two students per teacher. If you’re a beginner, our two or three-hour daily lesson package is designed to provide you with all the essential knowledge to ride safely on your own. We’ll focus on making you a self-sufficient rider, so you can enjoy the freedom of kitesurfing with confidence.</p><p>For intermediate kitesurfers, we’ve got you covered too. Your instructor will refresh your memory on previous lessons and then pick up your training from where you left off. This package is specially designed to take you to the next level and enhance your techniques, allowing you to further refine your kitesurfing skills.</p><p>So, no matter where you currently stand in your kitesurfing journey, our camp is here to support and elevate your experience, helping you become the kitesurfer you aspire to be!</p>        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

<section class="section section--soft" id="faq">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <h2 class="sec-title">About this camp</h2>
            <p class="sec-sub">Practical questions about booking and joining</p>    </div>
    <div class="faqgrid">
              <article class="faqcard">
          <h3 class="faqcard__q"><span class="faqcard__mark">?</span><span>How many lesson hours does the camp include?</span></h3>
          <p class="faqcard__a">Each camp lists its own total in the highlights above — 8 hours on the shorter camps, 10 on the mid-length ones and 12 on the longest. Sessions are normally two to three hours a day so you progress steadily without getting exhausted.</p>
        </article>
              <article class="faqcard">
          <h3 class="faqcard__q"><span class="faqcard__mark">?</span><span>What happens if there is no wind during my camp?</span></h3>
          <p class="faqcard__a">We switch to an alternative activity: a surf or wingfoil session, stand-up paddleboarding, or a cultural excursion. Essaouira is windy most of the year, so full no-wind days are rare. Because accommodation and instructor schedules are committed in advance, no partial refunds are issued for days with unsuitable wind or weather conditions.</p>
        </article>
              <article class="faqcard">
          <h3 class="faqcard__q"><span class="faqcard__mark">?</span><span>Is breakfast included?</span></h3>
          <p class="faqcard__a">Yes, daily breakfast at the riad is included in every camp price, along with your nights, towels and linens and Wi-Fi.</p>
        </article>
              <article class="faqcard">
          <h3 class="faqcard__q"><span class="faqcard__mark">?</span><span>Can I add extra lessons or extend my stay?</span></h3>
          <p class="faqcard__a">Yes. Extra hours can be added to any camp at the normal lesson rate, and extra nights in the riad can usually be arranged. Mention it in the note field when you send your booking request.</p>
        </article>
              <article class="faqcard">
          <h3 class="faqcard__q"><span class="faqcard__mark">?</span><span>What should I bring?</span></h3>
          <p class="faqcard__a">Swimwear, reef-safe sunscreen, a towel, a hat and water. All the technical equipment — board, kite or wing, wetsuit, harness, helmet and impact vest — is provided.</p>
        </article>
              <article class="faqcard">
          <h3 class="faqcard__q"><span class="faqcard__mark">?</span><span>How do I book this camp?</span></h3>
          <p class="faqcard__a">Use the Send Enquiry button on this page, choose the camp type you want and give us your dates and the number of people. We reply with availability and confirm your booking, usually the same day.</p>
        </article>
          </div>
  </div>
</section>

It was my second surf class and he spotted exactly where I could improve and what I was getting wrong from the very first moment. Next time I’m around Essaouira I’d definitely contact the guys in order to keep enjoying with very nice people around.</p>
                          <a class="rv__more" href="https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/107028440828570242875/reviews" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Read on Google</a>
                      </article>
                </div>
        <div class="rv-dots"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="center mt-32">
      <a class="btn btn--outline" href="https://maps.google.com/?cid=3109422313694105106" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Read our reviews on Google</a>
    </p>
  </div>
</section>
